raw_title: Book Review: ‘Awake Awake,’ by Fiona Mozley
description: In Fiona Mozley’s novel “Awake Awake,” a London writer returns to her hometown to unearth hazy memories of past friendships and traumas.
Food books by chefs and celebrities arrive by the landslide. “Voices From the Kitchen” highlights workers who get far less attention.

raw_title: Book Review: ‘The People’s Historian,’ by Dave Zirin
description: Dave Zirin traces the radical career of Howard Zinn, whose “A People’s History of the United States” has sold millions of copies.
